item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('caught-up.svg')
r = ET.parse(p).getroot()
assert r.tag == '{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}svg'
assert r.attrib['viewBox'] == '0 0 240 180'
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion' in p.read_text()
print(f'Valid SVG: {p} ({p.stat().st_size:,} bytes), 240 × 180, reduced-motion support.')
PY"
